title: Ordinary Engram work-session transport: release startup reservation on unwind
outcome: An unwinding control-process startup cannot leave a permanent occupied-None reservation or an indefinite legacy shutdown wait.
acceptance: A startup unwind relinquishes only its own still-current cold-start reservation without removing a published or replacement process.
A discriminating regression covers unwind before publication and subsequent same-session startup/shutdown behavior while preserving concurrent-start serialization and exact cleanup custody.
